During the interview, I was asked two Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) questions. The first question focused on **arrays**, with challenging constraints, while the second question was

Determine the angle between the hour and minute hands of

### Round 3: Virtual Technical Interview Round 2

**Duration**: 60 minutes  
**Difficulty Level**: Hard

**Experience**:  
This round was conducted by two senior engineers. The interview started with quick introductions followed by questions around my projects, especially my experience with Angular and Spring Boot.

Then came the main coding part:

* I was asked to solve [Reverse Nodes in K Group](https://leetcode.com/problems/reverse-nodes-in-k-group/)—a Leetcode Hard problem. I discussed the recursive approach and then implemented it using the linked list reversal technique. I also walked through test cases and explained each step.
* When prompted for optimization, I proposed a stack-based approach and the interviewer acknowledged the thought process.

The second half focused on Object-Oriented Programming:

* Topics included abstract classes, pure virtual functions, usage of new/delete, and the behavior of constructors/destructors.
* I was presented with different scenarios and asked which OOP concepts apply—sometimes combinations of multiple concepts.
* One open-ended question asked me to design a human body using OOP principles, which led to a broader discussion on design thinking.

Overall, the interviewers were engaged and even shared feedback with me toward the end.

**Key Learnings**:

* Expect Leetcode Hard-level questions and be prepared to reason through your solution.
* Deep understanding of OOP

JPMC | SWE III | Round 1 | Bangalore
Hi, I gave 1st round for JP Morgan Chase a few days ago for a Java Developer position.


There were Few Questions related to Java, Behavioral Questions and a Code Review.

1. Why do you want to join JPMC
2. What did you find in the job description that made you apply
3. Time when you faced a performance issue in your current project.
4. Challenging task you handled alone in your team.
5. Time when you had to choose between 2 options.
6. Overall your project related questions.

1. Syncronization and Locking related basic question, ConcurrentHashMap
2. Exceptions/Runtime Exceptions
3. Code Rewiew for a class which stores account,balance in a map, and had methods to update balance after a transaction and get that balance.


In code rewiew, I gave comment to use ConcurrentHashMap which he said is correct,but he asked for details which I did not know how its implemented.

And for why do you want to join JPMC , i just said I was looking for backend opportunites.
And I didnt even remember what was in the job description.

My current project is on C++, and considering my non engaging answers for "why JPMC", I dont think I am going to get selected in this.
